schema.label: Navigation menu
schema.help: Create and arrange menus under Blog → Menus.

css: .tb-centered-header{border-bottom:1px solid var(--tb-color-border);background:var(--tb-color-surface);text-align:center}.tb-centered-header__inner{max-width:var(--tb-centered-width);margin:auto;padding:28px 22px 0}.tb-centered-header__title{display:inline-block;color:var(--tb-color-secondary);font-size:clamp(30px,5vw,54px);font-weight:900;letter-spacing:-.045em;text-decoration:none}.tb-centered-header__tagline{margin:8px auto 22px;color:var(--tb-color-muted)}.tb-centered-header__nav{border-top:1px solid var(--tb-color-border);display:flex;justify-content:center;gap:4px;flex-wrap:wrap}.tb-centered-header__link{padding:14px 16px;color:var(--tb-color-text);text-decoration:none;font-weight:700}.tb-centered-header__link:hover{color:var(--tb-color-primary);background:var(--tb-color-background)}.tb-centered-header__parent{position:relative}.tb-centered-header__submenu{position:absolute;z-index:20;top:100%;left:50%;min-width:190px;padding:8px;border:1px solid var(--tb-color-border);border-radius:12px;background:var(--tb-color-surface);box-shadow:0 18px 45px color-mix(in srgb,var(--tb-color-secondary) 16%,transparent);display:none;transform:translateX(-50%);text-align:left}.tb-centered-header__parent:hover>.tb-centered-header__submenu,.tb-centered-header__parent:focus-within>.tb-centered-header__submenu{display:grid}.tb-centered-header__submenu .tb-centered-header__link{padding:10px 12px}.tb-menu-empty{color:var(--tb-color-muted);font-size:13px}
name: Centered Editorial Header
description: A centered publication masthead with navigation sourced from a saved menu.

menu_sources.empty_preview: <nav class="tb-centered-header__nav tb-menu-empty">Select a menu in block settings</nav>
